company_overview.headline: Who We Are
company_overview.body: T-Mat Global Technologies Private Limited is a DPIIT Recognized technology company headquartered in Pune, India, delivering enterprise-grade software engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, AI systems, staff augmentation, and IT consulting to clients in the United States, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, and globally. We operate at the intersection of startup agility and enterprise delivery discipline — combining the responsiveness of a modern technology firm with the standards of a tier-one systems integrator.

founder.headline: Leadership
founder.name: Sainath Shivaji Mitalakar
founder.title: Founder and Chief Executive Officer
founder.bio: Sainath Shivaji Mitalakar is a B.Tech Computer Engineer, AWS Certified DevOps Professional, and former DevOps Engineer on the System Design and Architecture team at T-Mobile USA. Recognized as a Top 25 Global DevOps Thought Leader by Thinkers360, he founded T-Mat Global to deliver enterprise-grade technology solutions from India to global clients — with the operational standards and time-zone alignment that US, UAE, and UK enterprises require.
credentials: Former DevOps Engineer — T-Mobile USA (System Design and Architecture)
Top 25 Global DevOps Thought Leader — Thinkers360

operating_model.headline: How We Operate
points: US time-zone aligned delivery — genuine real-time collaboration during EST and PST business hours
Dedicated offshore teams integrated directly into client workflows and sprint cadences
Milestone-based billing with transparent OKR-driven delivery governance
NDA-ready engagement frameworks and full IP ownership protection
Full statutory compliance: HR, payroll, background verification, and regulatory documentation managed end-to-end

items.title: Enterprise Standards at Offshore Economics
items.description: We deliver the engineering quality of a tier-one systems integrator — CI/CD pipelines, security hardening, automated testing, infrastructure as code — at offshore cost structures that provide 40-60% savings versus equivalent onshore teams.

items.title: Genuine US Time-Zone Alignment
items.description: We operate in US business hours from India — providing real-time collaboration, same-day responses, daily standups, and live sprint demonstrations. This is not nominal availability. This is genuine alignment.

items.title: AI-Native Engineering by Default
items.description: AI and automation are embedded into every engagement by default — not as an add-on. From MLOps infrastructure to intelligent automation pipelines, we engineer systems that are ready for the AI era.

items.title: Institutional Credibility
items.description: Full government recognition under Startup India (DIPP248437), complete corporate documentation (CIN, GST), and a founder with direct enterprise background at T-Mobile USA. Every engagement is contract-ready from day one.
